facts.command:
set -eu
PATH=/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
export PATH
LC_ALL=C
export LC_ALL
as_root() {
  if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; then
    "$@"
  else
    sudo -n "$@"
  fi
}
as_root sh -s <<'LEGACY2_BASELINE_SH'
set -eu
cd '/srv/legacy2/child-process-reaping'
printf '%s\n' 'SHA256 (regular files only)'
find . -type f -exec sha256sum {} \;
printf '%s\n' 'POSIX cksum (regular files only)'
find . -type f -exec cksum {} \;
printf '%s\n' 'Type, permissions, owner, group, length, mtime, allocated blocks and link targets'
find . -exec stat -c '%F|%a|%U|%G|%s|%Y|%b|%N' {} \;
LEGACY2_BASELINE_SH
